author: David Bombal
description:
Is Maltego’s free version still useful for OSINT investigations?

David looks at Maltego Basic and Basic+, how credits work across Graph and Search, and why access to trusted data sources can help investigators move faster when looking into a person of interest.
https://bit.ly/use-maltego-for-free

Thank you to Maltego for sponsoring this video!

#OSINT #Maltego #DigitalInvestigations
title: You need to learn Maltego in 2026
